description: Counter blinky on xc7z100ffg900 clocked from AB27, a bank 12 clock pad that enters the top clock row from the left
exercises: a clock entering CLK_HROW_TOP_R on a CK_IN_L lane above 3 (zynq7)
that every CLK_HROW_TOP_R feature the route uses is in prjxray-db, so fasm2frames assembles it
why: zynq7 segbits_clk_hrow_top_r.db lacked CK_IN_L4..13_ACTIVE (and the BUFH rows) until prjxray-db 86dd993 (db#35). nextpnr takes this clock in on CK_IN_L8, and with the older database fasm2frames stops on CLK_HROW_TOP_R.CLK_HROW_CK_IN_L8_ACTIVE: release 2026-10-13 failed so. The generated constraints put the clock on a bank 13 pad on every z100 package, so nothing else in the suite or the E2E reaches these rows.
